```go
package bookstore

import "sort"

// Cost returns the total price, in cents, of the books in the basket,
// grouped to give the biggest possible discount.
func Cost(books []int) int {
	counts := make([]int, 5)
	for _, book := range books {
		counts[book-1]++
	}
	sort.Sort(sort.Reverse(sort.IntSlice(counts)))

	// Form the largest sets possible, working from the most-copied books:
	// n5 sets of five, then n4 of four, and so on.
	n5 := counts[4]
	n4 := counts[3] - counts[4]
	n3 := counts[2] - counts[3]
	n2 := counts[1] - counts[2]
	n1 := counts[0] - counts[1]

	// A set of five plus a set of three costs 5160, while two sets of four
	// cost 5120, so trade as many five/three pairs as possible.
	k := n5
	if n3 < k {
		k = n3
	}
	n5 -= k
	n3 -= k
	n4 += 2 * k

	// Cost of a set of each size, in cents.
	setCost := [5]int{800, 1520, 2160, 2560, 3000}
	return n1*setCost[0] + n2*setCost[1] + n3*setCost[2] + n4*setCost[3] + n5*setCost[4]
}
```
